description: Build a necessary condition — a superset — for the preliminary selection of rows from an external source. This is NOT a legal answer and NOT SQL: the result is a typed tree and a manifest of the extensions up to TRUE. Every row that passes must then be computed in full by the engine, with a proof graph, on the same snapshot of the data. The binding is passed as a pinnable object; sourceSchemaContentHash is the actual hash of the source schema and is compared loudly with the pin. Case facts that carry provenance (origin, document, quote, extractor) are supplied to law_ask, not here. The confidence figure is read by the package EvidencePolicy, not by this tool and not by the engine.

goal.description: a StableId or a unique short name of the goal

legalTime.description: the date of the law YYYY-MM-DD; without it every window of every rule is taken into account

sourceSchemaContentHash.description: the actual sha256 of the source schema

name: law_screen
